column1: # Ordinary English words that genuinely collide with a name one of the fetched
# upstream trees declares. A word belongs here only when the specification uses it
# in its plain English sense and the collision is an accident of the upstream
# author having picked the same ordinary word. Game-platform and language
# vocabulary does not belong here; that is the deny-list inside
# checks/verify-spec-source-names.sh. Every entry carries its part of speech, so
# a reader can see at a glance that the excuse is a word and not a name.
